summary: Company/founder page of Silver Oak Capital (UK real estate debt brokerage). It profiles Jimmy Baillie, Founder & Managing Director, who founded the firm in 2019 to advise on loans between GBP 500k and GBP 20m secured on UK and overseas assets; it lists the debt advisory team (Connor Dooley, Senior Associate, Debt Advisory; Joe Berk, Associate, Debt Advisory; Sophia De Stefano, Relationship Manager) with bios covering education and experience, and (per seed) a 'Types Of Properties' list and the positioning 'one of Europe's leading large loan brokers'. Full body text was NOT retrieved: search results only exposed the title, the founder sentence, the founder's education and the team roles. Third-party sources (LinkedIn, Spear's, Weebly) give a different loan range (GBP 2m-20m) and different lender counts (500+ / 800+).

sections.content: [a][b][seed] Founded Silver Oak Capital in 2019; 'focussing on providing advice for loans between £500k – £20m' secured on UK and overseas assets. [b] Graduated from the University of Cape Town in 2010 with a BCom Honours Degree in Economics. [seed] Described as Managing Director; firm 'has focused on loans between £500K to £20m'. Rest of the bio (career history before 2019) not revealed.
